about.title: Engineering-First PCB Assembly & Prototyping
about.subtitle: Bridging world-class high-speed manufacturing expertise with responsive, local Southern California agility.
about.heroAlt: Yamaha SMT placement line at Goodtron's Vista, California facility

mission.title: Eliminating the friction between prototype design and assembly reality.
paragraphs: Too many hardware schedules slip in the gap between a finished design and a working board — a footprint that doesn't match the part, a BOM line that went obsolete, a vendor queue that puts a ten-board prototype behind a ten-thousand-board order.

Goodtron exists to close that gap. Every build starts with an engineering review of your BOM and design for assembly, runs on our own SMT line in Vista, California, and is coordinated directly with the people placing your parts.
attributes: In-house SMT line in North San Diego County, close to Southern California hardware teams.
Prototype and ECO builds turned in days, not weeks.
Free BOM & DFA pre-checks before parts are bought or boards are built.
Small runs are our core business — never squeezed in around large orders.

leader.heading: Meet the founder
leader.name: Daley Chak
leader.title: Founder & Technical Operations Lead
leader.photoLabel: Photo of Daley Chak coming soon
bio: Daley is a veteran electronics manufacturing specialist whose career spans the global hardware manufacturing hub of Shenzhen, China, through to Southern California's tech ecosystem.

Daley brings deep hands-on expertise in surface-mount technology (SMT), high-speed pick-and-place operation on Yamaha SMT platforms, fine-pitch BGA and 0201 placement, and rigorous assembly quality standards.
Daley partners directly with hardware engineers, robotics developers, and medical device innovators to move designs from schematic to physical assembly without costly revisions.

hero.body: Goodtron Electronics is a small, founder-led shop focused on SMT and PCB assembly for prototype and low-volume production. Below are the services we deliver in-house from Vista, California.

smt-assembly.title: SMT Assembly
smt-assembly.intro: Surface-mount assembly for modern board designs — from 0402 passives through fine-pitch ICs. Handled with careful setup, documented process notes, and post-reflow inspection.
bullets: DEK stencil printing for solder paste
smt-assembly.imgAlt: Close-up of a densely populated SMT board with fine-pitch components

pcb-assembly.title: PCB Assembly
pcb-assembly.intro: Full PCBA support — from receiving your BOM and Gerber files to shipping a working, inspected board. We review carefully up front, so you don't get surprises later.
pcb-assembly.imgAlt: Fully assembled printed circuit board with populated components

prototype-builds.title: Prototype Builds
prototype-builds.intro: First-article and early-revision prototypes handled seriously — the same review, sourcing, and inspection process we apply to larger runs.
bullets: Fast iteration between rev A → rev B
prototype-builds.imgAlt: Prototype board with jumper wires and multimeter during an early build

low-volume-production.title: Low-Volume Production
low-volume-production.intro: Consistent small and mid-volume runs — the same process notes, documentation, and inspection on every board, so quality stays repeatable as you scale.
low-volume-production.imgAlt: Close-up of a production-quality assembled PCB with a large IC in focus

through-hole-mixed.title: Through-Hole & Mixed-Technology Support
through-hole-mixed.intro: Mixed and hand-soldered assembly — connectors, power components, and boards that combine SMT with through-hole parts on the same build.
through-hole-mixed.imgAlt: Hand soldering a through-hole component onto a populated PCB

quality.title: Every board inspected. Standards you can specify.
quality.body: Prototype speed doesn't mean skipping inspection. Tell us the class and compliance context on your RFQ and we build and inspect to it.

equipment.title: Our SMT line & equipment.
equipment.body: The equipment behind the services above — flexible enough for small prototype runs and repeatable enough for low-volume production.

yamaha-ys12.name: Yamaha YS12
yamaha-ys12.body: Handles a broad component range from 0402 passives to fine-pitch ICs — well-suited to prototype and low-volume PCB assembly runs.

yamaha-ys12f.name: Yamaha YS12F
yamaha-ys12f.body: Second placement head paired with the YS12 to support mixed builds and give us flexibility across different board sizes and setups.
yamaha-ys12f.alt: Yamaha YS12F flexible SMT placement machine

vitronics-soltec-reflow.name: Vitronics Soltec Reflow
vitronics-soltec-reflow.body: Controlled, lead-free-compatible reflow profiles for reliable solder joints on both prototype and small-batch builds.

inspection-rework.name: Inspection & Rework
inspection-rework.body: Digital microscope stations for fine-pitch inspection and a hot-air rework setup for touch-ups on populated boards.

cta.title: Send what you have. We'll help scope the right path.
cta.body: BOM, Gerber files, a short description — anything works as a starting point. We reply directly, not through a sales funnel.
